lines.text: Narcissism doesn't always look like confidence.
Sometimes it looks charming, calm… even insecure.
The clue is what happens when their self-image gets threatened.
Criticism, rejection, or someone else getting attention can suddenly feel much bigger than the situation itself.
Because narcissism can be less about having a huge ego…
and more about constantly protecting a fragile one.
And that's why you can't diagnose narcissism from confidence, insecurity, or one bad reaction.
